questions.question: Java là ngôn ngữ gì và 'Write Once Run Anywhere' nghĩa là gì?

options.B: Java biên dịch thành bytecode chạy trên JVM — mọi OS có JVM đều chạy được cùng code
options.D: Java cần biên dịch lại cho mỗi OS

questions.explanation: Java source (.java) → javac → bytecode (.class) → JVM execute. JVM (Java Virtual Machine) là tầng trung gian, có thể cài trên Windows/Linux/Mac. WORA: cùng .class file chạy mọi nơi. JDK = JRE + compiler + tools. JRE = JVM + standard libraries. OpenJDK (free) vs Oracle JDK. LTS versions: Java 8, 11, 17, 21.

questions.question: OOP trong Java — 4 tính chất cơ bản?
questions.explanation: Encapsulation: gộp data + methods, hide internal state (private fields + public getters/setters). Inheritance: extends — tái sử dụng code từ parent class. Polymorphism: cùng method name, hành vi khác nhau (overriding, overloading). Abstraction: ẩn implementation chi tiết (abstract class, interface). Java không có multiple inheritance (class), nhưng có qua interfaces.

questions.question: Interface vs Abstract class trong Java — khi nào dùng cái nào?

options.B: Interface: contract (all abstract by default, Java 8+ default methods), multiple implements. Abstract class: partial implementation, single extends, có constructors

questions.explanation: Interface: không có state (chỉ constants), không constructor, multiple implements. Dùng cho: defining contracts (Serializable, Comparable, Runnable). Abstract class: có state, constructor, có thể có concrete methods. Dùng cho: partial implementation, template method pattern. Java 8+: default + static methods trong interface. Java 9+: private methods trong interface. Prefer interface over abstract class (SOLID: Dependency Inversion).

questions.question: Java Collections — List, Set, Map khi nào dùng cái nào?

options.B: List: ordered, duplicates allowed (ArrayList/LinkedList). Set: unique (HashSet/TreeSet). Map: key-value (HashMap/TreeMap). Chọn theo use case

questions.explanation: ArrayList: O(1) random access, O(n) insert/delete middle. LinkedList: O(1) insert/delete head/tail, O(n) random access. HashSet: O(1) add/remove/contains, unordered. TreeSet: sorted, O(log n). HashMap: O(1) average get/put, unordered. TreeMap: sorted by key, O(log n). LinkedHashMap: insertion order. ConcurrentHashMap: thread-safe. PriorityQueue: min/max heap. Choose based on: ordering needed? duplicates? thread-safety? time complexity?

questions.question: Exception handling trong Java — checked vs unchecked?

options.A: Tất cả exceptions đều cần try/catch
options.B: Checked: phải declare (throws) hoặc catch (IOException, SQLException). Unchecked: RuntimeException không bắt buộc (NullPointerException, ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException)

questions.explanation: Exception hierarchy: Throwable → Error (JVM errors, không handle) + Exception → RuntimeException (unchecked) + checked exceptions. try-catch-finally: finally LUÔN chạy. try-with-resources: AutoCloseable tự đóng. Multi-catch: catch (IOException | SQLException e). Custom exception: class MyException extends RuntimeException. Best practice: prefer unchecked exceptions, đừng swallow exceptions (empty catch), log properly.

questions.question: Java Generics dùng để làm gì?

options.B: Generics: type parameters cho type-safe code tại compile time, eliminate casts — List<String>, Method<T>, Class<T extends Comparable<T>>

questions.explanation: Without generics: List list = new ArrayList(); String s = (String) list.get(0); — ClassCastException runtime. With generics: List<String> list = new ArrayList<>() — type-safe, no cast. Generic method: <T> T getFirst(List<T> list). Bounded: <T extends Number>. Wildcard: List<?> (any type), List<? extends Number> (covariant), List<? super Integer> (contravariant). Type erasure: generics removed at compile time → no runtime overhead.

questions.question: Java Stream API và Lambda expressions — cách dùng thực tế?

options.A: Stream thay thế hoàn toàn vòng lặp
options.B: Stream: chaining lazy operations trên collections. Lambda: anonymous function implementation. Kết hợp: list.stream().filter().map().collect()

questions.explanation: Lambda: (params) -> expression. Method reference: String::toUpperCase. Stream pipeline: source → intermediate ops (filter, map, flatMap, sorted, distinct, limit) → terminal op (collect, forEach, reduce, count, findFirst). Lazy evaluation: intermediate ops không chạy cho đến khi terminal. Collectors: toList(), toMap(), groupingBy(), joining(). Parallel stream: .parallelStream() (cẩn thận với shared mutable state). Java 9+: Stream.of(), takeWhile(), dropWhile().

questions.question: Java Multithreading — Thread, Runnable, ExecutorService?

options.B: Thread/Runnable: cơ bản. ExecutorService: thread pool (không tạo thread mới mỗi lần). Future/CompletableFuture: async result handling
options.C: synchronized là đủ cho mọi case

questions.explanation: Thread: extends Thread hoặc implements Runnable. ExecutorService: Executors.newFixedThreadPool(n), submit(task) → Future. CompletableFuture (Java 8+): async chaining: CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> fetch()).thenApply(data -> process(data)).exceptionally(e -> fallback). synchronized: mutual exclusion nhưng không scalable. java.util.concurrent: Lock, ReadWriteLock, Semaphore, CountDownLatch, CyclicBarrier. Virtual threads (Java 21): lightweight threads cho I/O-bound (Project Loom).

questions.question: Java Memory Model — Heap, Stack, Garbage Collection?

options.B: Heap: objects, GC managed. Stack: method frames, local vars. GC: mark-and-sweep, generations (young/old/metaspace). -Xmx/-Xms để config
options.C: Stack và Heap là cùng một vùng memory
options.D: GC chạy synchronously trước mỗi allocation

questions.explanation: Stack: per-thread, local variables, method call frames, LIFO. Heap: shared, all objects, GC managed. Generations: Young Gen (Eden + Survivor) → Minor GC. Old Gen → Major GC. Metaspace (Java 8+): class metadata. GC algorithms: Serial, Parallel, G1 (default Java 9+), ZGC (low latency Java 11+), Shenandoah. Memory leaks: static collections, unclosed streams. -Xmx512m: max heap. -Xms256m: initial heap. GC tuning: complex, measure first.

questions.question: Design Pattern trong Java — Factory, Singleton, Builder?

options.B: Factory: tạo objects không lộ creation logic. Singleton: 1 instance (double-checked locking hoặc enum). Builder: construct complex objects step-by-step
options.D: Java 17 tích hợp tất cả design patterns

questions.explanation: Singleton (thread-safe): enum Singleton { INSTANCE; } hoặc double-checked locking với volatile. Factory Method: abstract createProduct() → subclass decide. Abstract Factory: family of related objects. Builder: new Pizza.Builder().size(LARGE).cheese(true).pepperoni(true).build(). Observer: Spring ApplicationEvent. Strategy: sort algorithms, payment methods. Decorator: Java I/O streams. Proxy: Spring AOP. Prefer composition over inheritance. SOLID principles > design patterns.

questions.question: Java Optional — tại sao và cách dùng đúng?

options.A: Optional là wrapper không cần thiết
options.B: Optional<T>: explicit nullable, thay thế null checks. Dùng: orElse, orElseGet, map, filter, ifPresent — KHÔNG dùng Optional.get() mà không isPresent()

questions.explanation: Optional.of(value): not null. Optional.ofNullable(value): có thể null. Optional.empty(): no value. Usage: optional.map(User::getEmail).orElse('unknown'). optional.ifPresent(u -> sendEmail(u)). optional.orElseThrow(() -> new NotFoundException()). Antipattern: optional.get() không check → NoSuchElementException. optional.isPresent() + optional.get() = giống null check thường. Không dùng Optional làm field trong class (serialization issues). Dùng để return type cho repository methods.

questions.question: Java app bị OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space. Debug thế nào?

options.B: Heap dump analysis (jmap/VisualVM/Eclipse MAT), tìm memory leak (objects không được GC), fix root cause, tối ưu memory usage

questions.explanation: OOM causes: (1) Memory leak: objects tham chiếu indefinitely (static lists, caches). (2) Large data loaded vào memory (pagination thay vì load all). (3) -Xmx quá nhỏ. Debug: jmap -dump:format=b,file=heap.hprof <pid>. Analyze với Eclipse MAT (Memory Analyzer Tool) hoặc VisualVM. Tìm: Retained Heap size, largest objects, reference chains. Enable OOM heap dump: -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError -XX:HeapDumpPath=/path. Fix: unregister listeners, use WeakReference, LRU cache, stream instead of collect all.

questions.question: Java NullPointerException — phòng chống và debug?

options.B: Java 14+ NullPointerException messages chỉ rõ variable nào null. Phòng chống: Optional, @NonNull/@Nullable, Objects.requireNonNull, fail-fast
options.D: Dùng null thường xuyên là OK

questions.explanation: Java 14+ helpful NPE: 'Cannot read field "name" because "user" is null' — chỉ rõ variable. Phòng chống: (1) Optional<T> cho nullable returns. (2) @NonNull/@Nullable (Lombok, JSR-305). (3) Objects.requireNonNull(param, 'param must not be null') — fail-fast. (4) Default values: String name = user != null ? user.getName() : 'Unknown'. (5) Collections: return empty list thay vì null. (6) Null Object Pattern. Avoid: passing null parameters, returning null from methods, chaining without null check.

questions.question: Java backend đang serving 10k TPS. GC pauses 500ms gây latency spikes. Fix?

options.B: Switch to low-latency GC (ZGC/Shenandoah), tune GC params, reduce object allocation, profile allocation hotspots, consider GC-free design

questions.explanation: GC pause investigation: jstat -gcutil <pid> 1000, GC logs (-Xlog:gc*). High pauses = Old gen full = long Major GC. Solutions: (1) ZGC (Java 15+ production ready): sub-millisecond pauses, good for large heaps. Enable: -XX:+UseZGC. (2) Shenandoah: similar to ZGC, RedHat contributed. (3) G1 tuning: -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200. (4) Allocation profiling: async-profiler (alloc mode) → find hotspot allocations → reduce object creation, use primitive arrays, pooling. (5) Off-heap: direct ByteBuffer, Netty pooled allocator for network buffers.
